request.description: Starts a partner application from a lead the firm has accepted (consent to share with the firm must be in place). Segment, business and category default to the lead; the borrower profile is created for the lead's person or business. The lead becomes `converted`, the assignment `completed` (`converted_to_application`). Partner context.
